notes:
Drawing is a rotated (90-deg) page and the crop is tight: two wires leave the top edge (x=145 and x=389) and two leave the bottom edge (x=168 and x=399); nothing leaves the left or right edges (checked pixel-wise on rows 0-2 and 509-511 and columns 0-1, 510-511).
Net map: 0 = the whole left-hand vertical wire plus everything hanging off it - GND 6 (drawn rotated, bars at x~105-120, lead running right at y~345), the left end of Resistor 2 (5k) via the T at (150,122), the left plate of Capacitor 4 via the junction dot at (157,345), and the two off-frame ends (up the left vertical to V-DC 3, down the left vertical to Inductor 5). n1 = right vertical between the bottom of Resistor 0 (top-right, cut by the crop) and the top of Resistor 1 (2k), joined by the T at (390,122) to the right end of Resistor 2. n2 = right vertical below Resistor 1: bottom of Resistor 1 -> T at (390,332) with the right plate of Capacitor 4 -> continues off the bottom edge at x=399 to Inductor 5. n3 = top lead of Resistor 0 off the top edge at x=389 to one terminal of V-DC 3. Resulting circuit: V-DC in series with Resistor 0 feeding node n1, Resistor 2 (5k) from n1 to ground, Resistor 1 (2k) from n1 to n2, and Capacitor 4 (5 mH label sits under the inductor; cap is the 4 uF part) in parallel with Inductor 5 from n2 to ground - a source-fed divider into a parallel LC, which is coherent.
OFF-FRAME COMPONENTS (not visible in the image at all):
 - V-DC 3, bbox centre (248.2,-113.7), i.e. above the top edge spanning x~217-280. It is the only component that can close the top of the loop, and the only two wires crossing the top edge are the left vertical (x=145, net 0) and the Resistor 0 lead (x=389, net n3). Inferred: terminal 0 = the lead facing left -> net 0, terminal 1 = the lead facing right -> n3. The +/- orientation is unknowable from the crop; 2-terminal order is not metric-relevant.
 - Inductor 5, bbox centre (253.1,548.8), below the bottom edge spanning x~208-298. The only two wires crossing the bottom edge are the left vertical (x=168, net 0) and the right vertical (x=399, net n2), and the inductor sits between them. Inferred: terminal 0 = left -> net 0, terminal 1 = right -> n2. Neither is marked unconnected: they are cut off by the crop, not dangling.
 - Resistor 0 is only partially visible (bbox y -11.6..91.2): its zigzag body is in frame, its top lead is not. Top terminal = n3 (to V-DC), bottom terminal = n1.
Judgment calls: (a) the horizontal at y~345 CROSSES the left vertical rather than ending on it, but there is an unmistakable junction blob at (157,345) at 10x, so GND / left vertical / capacitor left plate are one node - this is what makes the whole left rail net 0; (b) both right-hand meetings, (390,122) and (390,332), are plain Ts (the horizontal ends on the vertical), so they are junctions; (c) two-terminal order: verticals listed top-then-bottom (Resistors 0 and 1), horizontals left-then-right (Resistor 2, Capacitor 4, and the two off-frame parts).
